author: Phobiaxx
body:
I think sniper should be changed to:
Bow:Power 1
Arrows:20, add 15 to every kill
leather boots:with protection -1(just to show what team)
Wooden Sword:Sharpness -3, knockback 2, 1 time use, regenerates after 3 kills, or 1 minute.
ability: cloak:up to 20 seconds, when standing still(still can shoot), items can still be seen.
When cloaked, message: You are now cloaked!
If they move, instantly, they will become uncloaked. To cloak, they must stand still for 2 seconds, NO SHOOTING.(Also, particles still show when cloaked!) Basically, only their body, and boots are invisible.
This will make sniper's more realistic, snipers are supposed to camoflauge, because without it, they would be weak.
Feather:ability, when left clicked, they will have speed for 8 seconds, regenerates after 3 kills, or 2 minutes.
Red dye: when left clicked, the player will suicide, gaining 1 kill pt, but 1 death pt too. ( this is for snipers who can't kill anyone and run out of arrows, making them perfect targets, for the ragers!
and of course, they have 3 gapples
Explnation:
Snipers need more shots, otherwise, to me, sniper isn't O.P at all, but crummy.
The sword is just a tool for the sniper to make a getaway.. dealing only 1 damage
It can be used for snipers to knock an enemy far back, and shoot him dead.
Sniper would have strong offensive power, but extremely weak defensive, they will be able to get 2-hit by virtually any class.

This makes sniper WAY less OP, but better for those who can master the class, timing cloaks, knockback hits, and speed correctly.

what do you guys think? :D
